findings.issue: Task 9 says '~31 new' tests and 'see tech-spec Testing Strategy: 10 in test_orangetrack_source.py including integration, and 21 in test_telegraph_publisher.py'. findings.fix: Update Task 9 description: '10 unit + 1 integration in test_orangetrack_source.py = 11, and 24 in test_telegraph_publisher.py = 35 total new'. Update acceptance criterion to 'total ≥ 864' (829 + 35) or at minimum '≥ 860' with an explicit note that fewer than 864 warrants investigation.

findings.issue: Task 7 step 6 instructs writing the report to `logs/working/wave-3-security-audit.md` (relative path in the body), while the Acceptance Criteria state the full path as `work/orangetrack-rendering-fixes/logs/working/wave-3-security-audit.md`. findings.fix: In Task 7 step 6, change 'Написать отчёт в `logs/working/wave-3-security-audit.md`' to use the absolute or feature-relative path explicitly: 'Написать отчёт в `work/orangetrack-rendering-fixes/logs/working/wave-3-security-audit.md`' (from repo root) or 'Написать отчёт в `{feature_path}/logs/working/wave-3-security-audit.md`'.
